summary: Chippewa NF tower in Itasca County: 100-ft Aermotor ladder tower dated 1935 by one list (a 1934 survey already names it); no detection use since about 1972-73; listed standing.

facts.status_note: Listed as standing; the Forest Service stopped using it for fire detection around 1972/73

events.note: A Coast and Geodetic Survey station description from 1934 already refers to the Farley fire tower
Minnesota fire lookout list gives the year erected as 1935
Forest Service phased out towers around 1972/73; the list says this tower is no longer used for detection

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Minnesota list says the tower was erected in 1935, but the 1934 survey description already refers to the Farley fire tower. The story reports both; an earlier tower on the site is possible but not confirmed.

notes_for_editor: Build year conflicts (1934 survey reference vs 1935 erection); the story reports both. Current condition and access were not verified. The directions are from the 1934 survey and may be out of date. No rental listing was found. The Chippewa NF and recreation.gov pages were not reached; a Chippewa tower-loop page returned 403. The photo source_url follows the standard Commons file-page pattern and the credit comes from data/sources/commons_credits.json; neither was re-fetched.
